payload.message: LunchBot turn only. Read <LUNCHBOT_DATA_DIR>/raw_feed.md. Do not run scrapers. Format today's lunch options in concise English for WhatsApp. Send one WhatsApp group text summary to <WHATSAPP_GROUP_JID> using openclaw message send --channel whatsapp --target <WHATSAPP_GROUP_JID> --message. Then send a WhatsApp poll to the same group using openclaw message poll --channel whatsapp --target <WHATSAPP_GROUP_JID> --poll-question 'Lunch today?' with 2-12 short option names from the feed. Do not create agents and do not send DMs.
